text: …　…　…　おお　そうか　わしが　よんだのじゃった！

structure.jp: わしが　よんだのじゃった！
structure.en: it was me who called you!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb gives the explanation behind a situation; in the past form it shows he just remembered. じゃった is the old-man way of saying だった. よんだのじゃった = 'it was that I called you'.
